subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-immutable` with a merge base, docgate shall fail any modify, delete, or rename of a technical-design document present at the merge base under the configured tech-designs path, excluding the generated index artifacts, with the remedy naming supersession.
rationale: INV-41's CI half for the design class; merge is the freezing event
fit_criterion: fixture: modify/delete/rename of a merged design each red naming supersession; a design new in the PR edits green; index.md modification green; the PRD fence unaffected
